name: EOD Official
description: The numbers that are booked. Every product type ORE prices, each on its usual pair, a fine grid for bonds and a stop on any calibration that fails.

name: XVA Overnight
description: The overnight run that simulates exposure. Swaps and cross currency swaps use the American Monte Carlo engine on a fixed seed, and the rest keep the usual pair.

name: EOD Official
description: The numbers that are booked. Every product type ORE prices, each on its usual pair, a fine grid for bonds and a stop on any calibration that fails.

name: Intraday Indicative
description: A fast view of the book during the day. The usual pair for each product with a coarse bond grid. A failed calibration does not stop the run. The numbers are not official.

name: Pre-Trade Quick Price
description: The price a trader sees while a trade is built. It answers at once, so it uses a coarse bond grid and leaves out credit default swaps.

name: Risk Sensitivities
description: The prices that the delta, gamma and DV01 reports bump. A swap offers its analytic sensitivities, and a failed calibration stops the run so a bump never mixes two fits.

name: XVA Overnight
description: The overnight run that simulates exposure. Swaps and cross currency swaps use the American Monte Carlo engine on a fixed seed, and the rest keep the usual pair.

name: Regulatory FRTB
description: The prices behind the capital charge of the fundamental review. The sensitivities are analytic, the bond grid is fine and a failed calibration stops the run.

name: Regulatory SIMM
description: The prices behind the initial margin of uncleared derivatives. Bonds are not margined, so they are left out.

name: Stress Test Shocked
description: The prices under large shocks. The usual pair for each product, a fine bond grid, and a failed calibration does not stop the run because a shock can break a fit.

name: Quant Sandbox
description: Where the quants try a model before it goes live. Swaps use a small American Monte Carlo run. Nothing booked or filed uses it.
